name: Splitfield
description: A straight split in every cell, sliding from one edge to the other across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 @calc(6 + 88 * @x / @X)%, transparent @calc(6 + 88 * @x / @X)% 100%); mask: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 @calc(6 + 88 * @x / @X)%, transparent @calc(6 + 88 * @x / @X)% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
